# Senior Real Estate Planning — BrightWork Realty Advocates

> Consultative planning for senior homeowners and families navigating Prop 13, legacy homes, and transition timing.

BrightWork Realty Advocates. Ben Olsen, REALTOR. Serving Moraga, Lafayette, and Orinda (Lamorinda), CA. The BrightWork team has operated in Lamorinda since 1977. Ben Olsen has worked Lamorinda real estate since 2004.

## What this page is for

Consultative planning for senior homeowners and families navigating Prop 13, legacy homes, trusts, timing, and transition options in Lamorinda. Senior homeowners planning their next chapter and adult children who need a structured way to start the conversation before a crisis.
